consequence.statement: A new option to configure the service-account name in `flux create tenant`; nothing in the evidence says existing usage is affected.

original.statement: `flux create tenant` now lets the service-account name be configured.

decision.reason: [ev-7934fe792cbf] only says the service-account name is now configurable in `flux create tenant`, which is an opt-in CLI addition. It does not mention a changed default, removal, rejection or failure, so an operator who does nothing sees no stated change. That makes "none"/informational the fitting kind. Confidence is low because the release note does not say outright that existing behaviour stays the same.
